value.account:
CHANGED. (1) orchestrator/workflow/resume_slots.py (re-exported by state_projection.py): ResumeProjectionValidationError, slot index, enumerate_resume_slots / resolve_resume_step_id / resolve_call_boundary on WorkflowStateProjection, and the for_each / four-form repeat_until bookkeeping validation with the exact reasons and messages. Lowering now records CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias and IterationStepKeyProjection.max_iterations (needed for 'declared maximum range'); five structural characterization goldens gained only those fields. (2) resume_call_lineage.py: index_retry_lineage, CallFrameRetryLineage(Error), next_unused_retry_frame_id. (3) resume_projection_integrity.py: ResumeScopePath, ResumeProjectionIntegrityError, audit_scope (rows, current_step, frames, lineage; identity-only diagnostic), plus resolve_reached_call for calls. (4) calls.py: in resume mode execute_call resolves the boundary once, lets the boundary's current alias pick the callee, rejects completed-frame id collisions before grouping, builds the retry lineage, then runs checksum, bound-input, failed-predecessor and running-member audits in the specified order before creating any frame/executor; a callee projection failure is returned unwrapped (never call_failed) and promoted through ancestors; _is_workflow_lisp_target is now frontend_kind == 'workflow_lisp'; frame lookup by mapping order was removed. (5) executor.py: structural-root guard (checksum recheck via StateManager.calculate_checksum with the four reasons, then audit_scope) before the prologue; _handle_control_flow returns '_stop' for a sticky projection result and records it as run error; finalization keeps the projection diagnostic (failure.error is the cleanup's projection error or null; projection error arising only in finalization becomes the run error). loops.py: repeat_until promotes the diagnostic unwrapped; for_each stops without another iteration. (6) state.py: record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure write only status/error/updated_at atomically on the raw JSON (unknown root fields kept); RunState.from_dict keeps malformed for_each raw so the audit, not a TypeError, rejects it. (7) resume CLI: audit_scope after the checksum precheck and before observability persistence, sessions, process metadata and executor construction; prints the reason, exits 1, persists only the envelope (observability override persistence moved after the audit). (8) Delegated and reviewed: classic-YAML duplicate import alias / duplicate imports section detection from the YAML node graph before bundle construction; frontend_kind='workflow_lisp' set at the single compiler bundle-construction point (and no longer overwritten by build_frontend_bundle); forensic current_step handling in build_status_snapshot, the markdown report, the monitor email and the state-only report. (9) specs/state.md section, acceptance entries 201-210, capability matrix note. Tests: new test_resume_projection_integrity.py, test_resume_projection_runtime.py, and the agents' loader / provenance / forensic-status tests; the old gap-characterization tests (stale caller, ambiguity, callee-local corruption, CLI/direct-executor ordering, malformed frames, current_step name mismatch) were rewritten to assert the new behavior. Full suite: 4825 passed, 49 failed, all 48 baseline failures reproduced on a pristine archive of HEAD plus two timing-flaky adjudicated deadline tests that pass in isolation; a real CLI run/tamper/resume smoke check behaved as specified.

DECISIONS / DISCARDED. Unclaimed-row, then row, current_step, frame ordering is mine (spec does not order faults). Missing repeat_until frame row is accepted (lexical checkpoint restore legitimately pops it; rejecting broke three real Workflow Lisp resume tests). audit_scope returns quietly for objects with no projection (test doubles in cli tests). Considered a single class-based walker that recursed into nested frames at the root audit, and rejected it: the spec audits each scope only when it will execute. Considered keeping frame_id_with_overrides' resume branch; removed because it is exactly the mapping-order selection the change forbids. Existing tests changed because the new contract demands it: hand-built current_step fixtures gained step_id (mandatory); adjudication sidecar-drift test now mutates the sidecar instead of the workflow source (the executor now rechecks the checksum); hand-mutated Workflow Lisp resume tests opt into step-granular resume because compiled bundles now carry frontend_kind; the lexical loop-drift test now expects the earlier projection error.

NOT COVERED / RISKS. The untyped legacy for_each body path does not stop mid-iteration on a sticky error (it still stops before the next iteration). Fault precedence when several faults coexist, the field/offending value chosen for loop-bookkeeping reasons, and the reason used for a for_each current_index out of range (out-of-range message) are my choices where the spec is silent. Out-of-range or non-list completed_indices both use the out-of-range message. Unowned loop bookkeeping entries are not validated. No ExecutionCursorProjector (dashboard) change. Two goldens (stdlib_review_revise_loop, wcc_m4_implementation_phase_full_fixture) were already failing before this change and were not regenerated. Nothing was committed.
